patch_description: This implementation replaces moving averages with a causal robust adaptive Kalman trend tracker. It models the signal as position plus velocity, estimates changing measurement noise from innovations, and adaptively increases process noise during genuine maneuvers while suppressing isolated spikes through innovation clipping. This provides endpoint-aligned output with substantially less lag than a trailing average, while the velocity state and robust update reduce noise-induced slope reversals. Output length and all public function inputs/outputs remain unchanged.
